description: When the user wants a doctor, nurse or IV drip at their hotel/home in Da Nang, Hoi An, Ho Chi Minh City, Phong Nha, Dong Hoi, Nha Trang, Hue, Phu Quoc or Ninh Binh, offer: "I can book this for you now, I just need a few details." Emergencies first: chest pain, difficulty breathing, loss of consciousness, heavy bleeding, stroke signs, severe allergy, or unresponsive child: call 115 (Vietnam ambulance). Collect all required fields one question at a time. Never guess a value. Check international phone format with country code. Never quote a price: doctor quotes after assessment. No confirmation by agent; team confirms upon contact.

accommodation.description: Hotel name and room number, or street address

consent.description: Explicit user consent to be contacted by Viet Home Doctor

contact_value.description: E.164 number with +country code for whatsapp/zalo/kakaotalk/phone_call; @username for telegram; ID for wechat or line

idempotency_key.description: Unique key or UUID to prevent duplicate submissions

patient_type.description: Whether the patient is an adult or child

src.description: Source of the request: always "agent" when an AI assistant sends it

symptoms.description: Symptoms in the patient's own words (no diagnosis)

name: request_home_visit
title: Request a home or hotel visit
